source.label: Marvel.com Marvel Universe wiki: Ant-Man (Scott Lang) (archived 8 July 2018)

powerOrigins.detail: Pym Particles carried in his belt let him shrink or grow, the power at the heart of the Ant-Man suit he stole from Hank Pym.
Hank Pym's cybernetic helmet commands insects, and wrist gauntlets fire bio-electric blasts.
An electrical engineer with a master's degree and a skilled thief before he ever wore the suit.

abilities.name: Size alteration
abilities.detail: Pym Particles let him shrink to about half an inch tall or grow to giant size, and can resize other objects too.

abilities.name: Full-size punch when tiny
abilities.detail: Shrunk, he keeps his normal mass, so a blow from a half-inch Ant-Man lands like a punch from a full-sized man.

abilities.name: Giant-size strength
abilities.detail: At large sizes he can lift more than 50 tons and shrug off Doctor Doom's energy blasts.

abilities.name: Pym Particle toughness
abilities.detail: He learned to tap the strength and durability axes of Pym Particles without changing size, once surviving a point-blank nuclear blast unharmed.

abilities.name: Insect command
abilities.detail: His cybernetic helmet lets him talk to and direct insects up to about a mile away, sending hundreds of ants against a single foe.

abilities.name: Gauntlet blasts
abilities.detail: Wrist gauntlets fire bio-electric blasts whose force he can adjust.

abilities.name: Engineer and thief
abilities.detail: Holds a master's in electrical engineering and could get past and hack advanced security systems even before he had the suit.

feats.text: Stole the Ant-Man suit to save his sick daughter, broke into Cross Technological Enterprises, freed the surgeon held there and beat Darren Cross.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Marvel Premiere Vol 1 47
Marvel Fandom wiki: Marvel Premiere Vol 1 48

feats.text: Doctor Doom's gauntlet blasts had no effect on him; he crushed the gauntlets and tore Doom's armour apart with his bare hands.
Shrank to microscopic size and, guided by Dr. Sondheim, fought his daughter Cassie's white blood cells so her body would accept a new heart.
Switched off his suit's regulator and shrank small enough to pass through the titanium of Darren Cross's Yellowjacket suit, disabling it from inside.
Grew into Giant-Man mid-battle at Leipzig-Halle Airport, a size he had tested only once, throwing War Machine and ripping the wing off a plane.

sources.label: MCU Wiki: Captain America: Civil War

feats.text: As Giant-Man in the Battle of Earth he punched a Leviathan out of the sky and crushed Cull Obsidian underfoot.
